sentence: This project buys a 3D printer that prints three different materials at once to study how those materials join.
This project builds and studies models of quantum gravity in three spacetime dimensions, where the problem is simpler.
This project makes building blocks of RNA that respond to light so that RNA functions can be turned on and off.
This project builds computer methods that analyze sensor and drone data on farms and keep working when data is missing.
This project explores how people use interface technologies such as extended reality and mobile interfaces through hands-on research projects.
This project studies how foldable bottlebrush polymers are built and how their structure sets their mechanical properties.
This project studies how frequent prescribed fire affects soil microbial communities in longleaf pine forests.
This project holds a workshop on statistical methods for spatial environmental data, such as air and water pollution.
This project builds a tutoring system that creates cybersecurity threat scenarios and tests how well people judge them.
This project builds design methods and tools for energy-based models, which represent uncertainty in data.
This project supports an open-source software tool that models how hydrogen moves through materials and builds a community around it.
This project studies how eelgrass wasting disease spreads between plants in the ocean and how warming and other living things affect it.
This project builds a microscope method that lets researchers see tiny molecules deep inside living brain tissue.
This project designs control methods that help groups of robots keep working together in space when parts or sensors fail.
This project studies how artificial light at night changes the way night-blooming plants and hawkmoths interact.
